description: Fetch the full, untruncated document for a single message by its _id and _index (both returned by search). Use after a concise search to inspect one hit in full.

index.description: The message _index from a search result.

instance.description: Graylog instance to query. Active: "instance_1". Default: "instance_1".

messageId.description: The message _id from a search result.

name: get_message
